_template_note: Template for outputs/pesn/v542_backbone_50k/plan/a0_reuse_decision.json (plan §5 / ADR-0033 §2.5). Binary decision record: reuse_e0_x3 OR retrain_a0_x3. FROZEN WP0 RULING = retrain_a0_x3: the new interface contract, construction-RNG isolation, by-id param groups and evaluation-identity change make V541 E0 training reuse unsignable, so the shadow-run/reuse branch is intentionally NOT implemented in V5.4.2. V541 E0x3 stays parity/historical-only and is never an H2/H3 comparator. INSTANCE REQUIRED BEFORE FORMAL T1: this template is NOT the decision record — the instance at outputs/pesn/v542_backbone_50k/plan/a0_reuse_decision.json must exist with decision=retrain_a0_x3 before any formal T1 run (config a0_baseline.decision_record_instance); the instance is intentionally ABSENT during WP0 authoring by design and must be generated + signed before T1 (fix-5 C7). A0×3 formal + V542-A0-sanity-band PASS is a hard precondition for any T1 A1-A4 formal run (fix-5 C5). gate-0 A5 2026-10-30 (P3 lane D): this record is the t1_start_requires record requirement a0_reuse_decision_record, machine-checked by the schema validator (prereg: t1_blocked reason; --formal: typed V542_RECORD_MISSING when absent/unreadable, V542_RECORD_MISMATCH when decision != retrain_a0_x3 or runs drift). gate-3 B2/C2 2026-10-30 (P3 remediation lane R2): the validator now ALSO requires the instance to mirror the frozen config — config_path must equal config/campaigns/pes2ts_v542_backbone_50k.yaml, campaign_id must equal PES2TS_V542_BACKBONE_50K, schema must equal this template's schema id pes2ts_v542_a0_reuse_decision_v1 — and VERIFIES the declared record_sha256 against the canonical digest sha256(canonical_bytes(instance payload without the record_sha256 field)) using the identity module's ONE recipe (pes2ts_core.pesn.models.v542.identity.canonical_bytes); a missing digest is V542_RECORD_MISSING, a wrong digest is V542_RECORD_MISMATCH. The sibling runplan_pin_record is verified by the WP5 runner at the runplan freeze, NOT by this validator at WP0.
record_sha256_note: fill at freeze time: sha256 of canonical_bytes(instance JSON payload with record_sha256 removed) — compact sorted-key JSON, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false (identity module recipe); validator verifies at --formal (gate-3 C2)
